## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Duggatikathā* (Kv 12.9) is a debate section in the twelfth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. The controversy revolves around the thesis *diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatī ti* ("Is a person possessing right view free from birth in a lower form of existence?"), a proposition associated in the tradition with the Uttarāpathakas [Dutt 1978].
SuttaCentral records no curated external parallels for the discourse and notes one translation [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis via DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, with 292 matching passages distributed across 18 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial internal reuse occurs with other debates in the *Kathāvatthu*, notably the *Vacībhedakathā* (Kv 2.5), *Parihānikathā* (Kv 1.2), the adjacent *Jīvitāvoropanakathā* (Kv 12.8) and *Sattamabhavikakathā* (Kv 12.10), as well as the *Aṭṭhamakakathā* (Kv 3.5), *Aṭṭhamakassaindriyakathā* (Kv 3.6), and *Iddhibalakathā* (Kv 11.5) [DharmaNexus]. Outside the *Kathāvatthu*, DharmaNexus aligns passages with canonical and paracanonical works including the *Kusalattika* of the *Paṭṭhāna* (Patthana 1.2), the *Chakkanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 6), the *Pāsarāsi Sutta* (MN 26), the *Vipallāsakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.8), and the commentary *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records low-scoring machine alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Āryabodhisattvapiṭakasūtra* [DharmaNexus].
